768|/-- The coercion from `Finset` to `Set` as a `MonoidHom`. -/
   769|@[to_additive "The coercion from `Finset` to `set` as an `AddMonoidHom`."]
   770|noncomputable def coeMonoidHom : Finset α →* Set α where
   771|  toFun := (↑)
   772|  map_one' := coe_one
   773|  map_mul' := coe_mul
   774|
   775|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   776|theorem coe_coeMonoidHom : (coeMonoidHom : Finset α → Set α) = (↑) :=
   777|  rfl
   778|
   779|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   780|theorem coeMonoidHom_apply (s : Finset α) : coeMonoidHom s = s :=
   781|  rfl
   782|
   783|/-- Lift a `MonoidHom` to `Finset` via `image`. -/
   784|@[to_additive (attr := simps) "Lift an `add_monoid_hom` to `Finset` via `image`"]
   785|def imageMonoidHom [MulOneClass β] [FunLike F α β] [MonoidHomClass F α β] (f : F) :
   786|    Finset α →* Finset β :=
   787|  { imageMulHom f, imageOneHom f with }
   788|
   789|end MulOneClass
   790|
   791|section Monoid
   792|
   793|variable [Monoid α] {s t : Finset α} {a : α} {m n : ℕ}
   794|
   795|@[to_additive (attr := simp, norm_cast)]
   796|theorem coe_pow (s : Finset α) (n : ℕ) : ↑(s ^ n) = (s : Set α) ^ n := by
   797|  change ↑(npowRec n s) = (s : Set α) ^ n
   798|  induction' n with n ih
   799|  · rw [npowRec, pow_zero, coe_one]
   800|  · rw [npowRec, pow_succ, coe_mul, ih]
   801|
   802|/-- `Finset α` is a `Monoid` under pointwise operations if `α` is. -/
   803|@[to_additive "`Finset α` is an `AddMonoid` under pointwise operations if `α` is. "]
   804|protected def monoid : Monoid (Finset α) :=
   805|  coe_injective.monoid _ coe_one coe_mul coe_pow
   806|
   807|scoped[Pointwise] attribute [instance] Finset.monoid Finset.addMonoid
   808|
   809|-- `Finset.pow_left_monotone` doesn't exist since it would syntactically be a special case of
   810|-- `pow_left_mono`
   811|
   812|@[to_additive]
   813|protected lemma pow_right_monotone (hs : 1 ∈ s) : Monotone (s ^ ·) :=
   814|  pow_right_monotone <| one_subset.2 hs
   815|
   816|@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
   817|lemma pow_subset_pow_left (hst : s ⊆ t) : s ^ n ⊆ t ^ n := subset_of_le (pow_left_mono n hst)
   818|
   819|@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
   820|lemma pow_subset_pow_right (hs : 1 ∈ s) (hmn : m ≤ n) : s ^ m ⊆ s ^ n :=
   821|  Finset.pow_right_monotone hs hmn
   822|
   823|@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
   824|lemma pow_subset_pow (hst : s ⊆ t) (ht : 1 ∈ t) (hmn : m ≤ n) : s ^ m ⊆ t ^ n :=
   825|  (pow_subset_pow_left hst).trans (pow_subset_pow_right ht hmn)
   826|
   827|@[to_additive]
   828|lemma subset_pow (hs : 1 ∈ s) (hn : n ≠ 0) : s ⊆ s ^ n := by
   829|  simpa using pow_subset_pow_right hs <| Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hn
   830|
   831|@[deprecated (since := "2024-11-19")] alias pow_subset_pow_of_one_mem := pow_subset_pow_right
   832|
   833|@[deprecated (since := "2024-11-19")]
   834|alias nsmul_subset_nsmul_of_zero_mem := nsmul_subset_nsmul_right
   835|
   836|@[to_additive]
   837|lemma pow_subset_pow_mul_of_sq_subset_mul (hst : s ^ 2 ⊆ t * s) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
   838|    s ^ n ⊆ t ^ (n - 1) * s := subset_of_le (pow_le_pow_mul_of_sq_le_mul hst hn)
   839|
   840|@[to_additive (attr := simp) nsmul_empty]
   841|lemma empty_pow (hn : n ≠ 0) : (∅ : Finset α) ^ n = ∅ := match n with | n + 1 => by simp [pow_succ]
   842|
   843|@[to_additive]
   844|lemma Nonempty.pow (hs : s.Nonempty) : ∀ {n}, (s ^ n).Nonempty
   845|  | 0 => by simp
   846|  | n + 1 => by rw [pow_succ]; exact hs.pow.mul hs
   847|
   848|set_option push_neg.use_distrib true in
   849|@[to_additive (attr := simp)] lemma pow_eq_empty : s ^ n = ∅ ↔ s = ∅ ∧ n ≠ 0 := by
   850|  constructor
   851|  · contrapose!
   852|    rintro (hs | rfl)
   853|    -- TODO: The `nonempty_iff_ne_empty` would be unnecessary if `push_neg` knew how to simplify
   854|    -- `s ≠ ∅` to `s.Nonempty` when `s : Finset α`.
   855|    -- See https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/287929-mathlib4/topic/push_neg.20extensibility
   856|    · exact nonempty_iff_ne_empty.1 (nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 hs).pow
   857|    · rw [← nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
   858|      simp
   859|  · rintro ⟨rfl, hn⟩
   860|    exact empty_pow hn
   861|
   862|@[to_additive (attr := simp) nsmul_singleton]
   863|lemma singleton_pow (a : α) : ∀ n, ({a} : Finset α) ^ n = {a ^ n}
   864|  | 0 => by simp [singleton_one]
   865|  | n + 1 => by simp [pow_succ, singleton_pow _ n]
   866|
   867|@[to_additive] lemma pow_mem_pow (ha : a ∈ s) : a ^ n ∈ s ^ n := by
   868|  simpa using pow_subset_pow_left (singleton_subset_iff.2 ha)
   869|
   870|@[to_additive] lemma one_mem_pow (hs : 1 ∈ s) : 1 ∈ s ^ n := by simpa using pow_mem_pow hs
   871|
   872|@[to_additive]
   873|lemma inter_pow_subset : (s ∩ t) ^ n ⊆ s ^ n ∩ t ^ n := by apply subset_inter <;> gcongr <;> simp
   874|
   875|@[to_additive (attr := simp, norm_cast)]
   876|theorem coe_list_prod (s : List (Finset α)) : (↑s.prod : Set α) = (s.map (↑)).prod :=
   877|  map_list_prod (coeMonoidHom : Finset α →* Set α) _
   878|
   879|@[to_additive]
   880|theorem mem_prod_list_ofFn {a : α} {s : Fin n → Finset α} :
   881|    a ∈ (List.ofFn s).prod ↔ ∃ f : ∀ i : Fin n, s i, (List.ofFn fun i => (f i : α)).prod = a := by
   882|  rw [← mem_coe, coe_list_prod, List.map_ofFn, Set.mem_prod_list_ofFn]
   883|  rfl
   884|
   885|@[to_additive]
   886|theorem mem_pow {a : α} {n : ℕ} :
   887|    a ∈ s ^ n ↔ ∃ f : Fin n → s, (List.ofFn fun i => ↑(f i)).prod = a := by
   888|  simp [← mem_coe, coe_pow, Set.mem_pow]
   889|
   890|@[to_additive]
   891|lemma card_pow_le : ∀ {n}, #(s ^ n) ≤ #s ^ n
   892|  | 0 => by simp
   893|  | n + 1 => by rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]; refine card_mul_le.trans (by gcongr; exact card_pow_le)
   894|
   895|@[to_additive]
   896|theorem mul_univ_of_one_mem [Fintype α] (hs : (1 : α) ∈ s) : s * univ = univ :=
   897|  eq_univ_iff_forall.2 fun _ => mem_mul.2 ⟨_, hs, _, mem_univ _, one_mul _⟩
   898|
   899|@[to_additive]
   900|theorem univ_mul_of_one_mem [Fintype α] (ht : (1 : α) ∈ t) : univ * t = univ :=
   901|  eq_univ_iff_forall.2 fun _ => mem_mul.2 ⟨_, mem_univ _, _, ht, mul_one _⟩
   902|
   903|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   904|theorem univ_mul_univ [Fintype α] : (univ : Finset α) * univ = univ :=
   905|  mul_univ_of_one_mem <| mem_univ _
   906|
   907|@[to_additive (attr := simp) nsmul_univ]
   908|theorem univ_pow [Fintype α] (hn : n ≠ 0) : (univ : Finset α) ^ n = univ :=
   909|  coe_injective <| by rw [coe_pow, coe_univ, Set.univ_pow hn]
   910|
   911|@[to_additive]
   912|protected theorem _root_.IsUnit.finset : IsUnit a → IsUnit ({a} : Finset α) :=
   913|  IsUnit.map (singletonMonoidHom : α →* Finset α)
   914|
   915|@[to_additive]
   916|lemma image_op_pow (s : Finset α) : ∀ n : ℕ, (s ^ n).image op = s.image op ^ n
   917|  | 0 => by simp [singleton_one]
   918|  | n + 1 => by rw [pow_succ, pow_succ', image_op_mul, image_op_pow]
   919|
   920|@[to_additive]
   921|lemma map_op_pow (s : Finset α) :
   922|    ∀ n : ℕ, (s ^ n).map opEquiv.toEmbedding = s.map opEquiv.toEmbedding ^ n
   923|  | 0 => by simp [singleton_one]
   924|  | n + 1 => by rw [pow_succ, pow_succ', map_op_mul, map_op_pow]
   925|
   926|@[to_additive]
   927|lemma product_pow [Monoid β] (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β) : ∀ n, (s ×ˢ t) ^ n = (s ^ n) ×ˢ (t ^ n)
   928|  | 0 => by simp
   929|  | n + 1 => by simp [pow_succ, product_pow _ _ n]
   930|
   931|end Monoid
   932|
   933|section CommMonoid
   934|
   935|variable [CommMonoid α]
   936|
   937|/-- `Finset α` is a `CommMonoid` under pointwise operations if `α` is. -/
   938|@[to_additive "`Finset α` is an `AddCommMonoid` under pointwise operations if `α` is. "]
   939|protected noncomputable def commMonoid : CommMonoid (Finset α) :=
   940|  coe_injective.commMonoid _ coe_one coe_mul coe_pow
   941|
   942|scoped[Pointwise] attribute [instance] Finset.commMonoid Finset.addCommMonoid
   943|
   944|end CommMonoid
   945|
   946|section DivisionMonoid
   947|
   948|variable [DivisionMonoid α] {s t : Finset α} {n : ℤ}
   949|
   950|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   951|theorem coe_zpow (s : Finset α) : ∀ n : ℤ, ↑(s ^ n) = (s : Set α) ^ n
   952|  | Int.ofNat _ => coe_pow _ _
   953|  | Int.negSucc n => by
   954|    refine (coe_inv _).trans ?_
   955|    exact congr_arg Inv.inv (coe_pow _ _)
   956|
   957|@[to_additive]
   958|protected theorem mul_eq_one_iff : s * t = 1 ↔ ∃ a b, s = {a} ∧ t = {b} ∧ a * b = 1 := by
   959|  simp_rw [← coe_inj, coe_mul, coe_one, Set.mul_eq_one_iff, coe_singleton]
   960|
   961|/-- `Finset α` is a division monoid under pointwise operations if `α` is. -/
   962|@[to_additive
   963|  "`Finset α` is a subtraction monoid under pointwise operations if `α` is."]
   964|protected noncomputable def divisionMonoid : DivisionMonoid (Finset α) :=
   965|  coe_injective.divisionMonoid _ coe_one coe_mul coe_inv coe_div coe_pow coe_zpow
   966|
   967|scoped[Pointwise] attribute [instance] Finset.divisionMonoid Finset.subtractionMonoid
   968|
   969|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   970|theorem isUnit_iff : IsUnit s ↔ ∃ a, s = {a} ∧ IsUnit a := by
   971|  constructor
   972|  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
   973|    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, h⟩ := Finset.mul_eq_one_iff.1 u.mul_inv
   974|    refine ⟨a, ha, ⟨a, b, h, singleton_injective ?_⟩, rfl⟩
   975|    rw [← singleton_mul_singleton, ← ha, ← hb]
   976|    exact u.inv_mul
   977|  · rintro ⟨a, rfl, ha⟩
   978|    exact ha.finset
   979|
   980|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   981|theorem isUnit_coe : IsUnit (s : Set α) ↔ IsUnit s := by
   982|  simp_rw [isUnit_iff, Set.isUnit_iff, coe_eq_singleton]
   983|
   984|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   985|lemma univ_div_univ [Fintype α] : (univ / univ : Finset α) = univ := by simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
   986|
   987|@[to_additive] lemma subset_div_left (ht : 1 ∈ t) : s ⊆ s / t := by
   988|  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; exact subset_mul_left _ <| by simpa
   989|
   990|@[to_additive] lemma inv_subset_div_right (hs : 1 ∈ s) : t⁻¹ ⊆ s / t := by
   991|  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; exact subset_mul_right _ hs
   992|
   993|@[to_additive (attr := simp) zsmul_empty]
   994|lemma empty_zpow (hn : n ≠ 0) : (∅ : Finset α) ^ n = ∅ := by cases n <;> aesop
   995|
   996|@[to_additive]
   997|lemma Nonempty.zpow (hs : s.Nonempty) : ∀ {n : ℤ}, (s ^ n).Nonempty
   998|  | (n : ℕ) => hs.pow
   999|  | .negSucc n => by simpa using hs.pow
  1000|
  1001|set_option push_neg.use_distrib true in
  1002|@[to_additive (attr := simp)] lemma zpow_eq_empty : s ^ n = ∅ ↔ s = ∅ ∧ n ≠ 0 := by
  1003|  constructor
  1004|  · contrapose!
  1005|    rintro (hs | rfl)
  1006|    · exact nonempty_iff_ne_empty.1 (nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 hs).zpow
  1007|    · rw [← nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
  1008|      simp
  1009|  · rintro ⟨rfl, hn⟩
  1010|    exact empty_zpow hn
  1011|
  1012|@[to_additive (attr := simp) zsmul_singleton]
  1013|lemma singleton_zpow (a : α) (n : ℤ) : ({a} : Finset α) ^ n = {a ^ n} := by cases n <;> simp
  1014|
  1015|end DivisionMonoid
  1016|
  1017|/-- `Finset α` is a commutative division monoid under pointwise operations if `α` is. -/
  1018|@[to_additive subtractionCommMonoid
  1019|      "`Finset α` is a commutative subtraction monoid under pointwise operations if `α` is."]
  1020|protected noncomputable def divisionCommMonoid [DivisionCommMonoid α] :
  1021|    DivisionCommMonoid (Finset α) :=
  1022|  coe_injective.divisionCommMonoid _ coe_one coe_mul coe_inv coe_div coe_pow coe_zpow
  1023|
  1024|scoped[Pointwise] attribute [instance] Finset.divisionCommMonoid Finset.subtractionCommMonoid
